jobs.title: Rekrutmen Pegawai Pemerintah Non Pegawai Negeri (PPNPN) KPP Pratama
jobs.description: Kantor Pelayanan Pajak atau KPP adalah salah satu unit atau cabang dari Direktorat Jenderal Pajak di Indonesia. Kantor ini bertugas untuk memberikan pelayanan terkait perpajakan kepada wajib pajak yang berada di wilayahnya. Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama biasanya melayani wajib pajak yang memiliki jenis usaha atau perorangan dengan volume transaksi yang lebih kecil dibandingkan dengan kantor pajak yang lebih besar seperti Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Besar. Penerimaan Pegawai Pemerintah Non Pegawai Negeri (PPNPN) KPP Pratama. Tugas utama Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama adalah mengumpulkan, mengelola, dan memberikan informasi serta panduan kepada wajib pajak mengenai peraturan perpajakan, pelaporan pajak, serta pembayaran pajak. Mereka juga melakukan pemeriksaan pajak untuk memastikan kepatuhan wajib pajak terhadap aturan perpajakan. Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama ini biasanya tersebar di berbagai wilayah di seluruh Indonesia untuk memudahkan wajib pajak dalam mengakses layanan perpajakan tanpa harus pergi ke kantor pajak yang lebih besar. Tujuannya adalah untuk meningkatkan kepatuhan perpajakan dan memfasilitasi wajib pajak dalam memenuhi kewajibannya terkait pajak. Lowongan Kerja Kantor Pelayanan Pajak (KPP) Pratama Saat ini KPP Pratama Majene membuka lowongan kerja untuk posisi Pramubakti untuk mendukung pelaksanaan tugas dan fungsi KPP Pratama. Pegawai Pemerintah Non Pegawai Negeri (PPNPN) KPP Pratama Majene 1. Tenaga Keamanan/Security (KODE: SEC) KRITERIA PELAMAR WNI, diutamakan pria untuk kebutuhan pola dinas/piket malam Usia minimal 20 tahun dan maksimal 32 tahun per 1 Januari 2027 Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau sederajat Tinggi badan minimal 160 cm dengan berat badan proporsional Memiliki Sertifikat Pelatihan Satpam minimal Gada Pratama dan KTA aktif Sehat jasmani dan rohani, tidak bertato/tindik, tidak buta warna, dan bebas narkoba Disiplin, berintegritas tinggi, tegas, dan berorientasi pada pelayanan prima SIM A/C aktif menjadi nilai tambah BERKAS LAMARAN Pasfoto

jobs.title: Rekrutmen Officer Development Program (ODP) Bank Syariah Nasional (BSN)
jobs.description: PT Bank Syariah Nasional (BSN) merupakan institusi perbankan syariah yang berkomitmen menghadirkan layanan keuangan yang amanah, inovatif, dan berkelanjutan sesuai prinsip syariah. Rekrutmen Officer Development Program Bank Syariah Nasional (BSN). PT Bank Syariah Nasional (BSN) adalah entitas perbankan syariah baru hasil spin-off Unit Usaha Syariah (UUS) PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk (BTN) yang resmi beroperasi penuh pada Desember 2025. BSN berfokus pada inovasi digital, termasuk penggunaan aplikasi Bale Syariah , dengan aset sekitar Rp71 triliun dan menargetkan pertumbuhan signifikan sebagai salah satu bank syariah terbesar di Indonesia. BSN berkomitmen menjadi mitra keuangan yang berkah dan amanah, menargetkan nasabah yang membutuhkan layanan perbankan cepat, mudah, dan sesuai prinsip syariah. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Nasional (BSN) Saat ini PT Bank Syariah Nasional memberikan kesempatan untuk kualifikasi sebagai berikut: Officer Development Program (ODP) Talent Sourcing Melalui Officer Development Program (ODP), Anda akan dipersiapkan menjadi calon pemimpin masa depan Bank Syariah Nasional melalui program pengembangan yang komprehensif dan terstruktur. Sebagai peserta ODP, Anda akan mendapatkan: Program pelatihan intensif (classical training) terkait perbankan syariah, operasional bank, layanan nasabah, serta pengembangan kepemimpinan On-the-Job Training (OJT) melalui rotasi di berbagai unit kerja strategis Pemahaman menyeluruh mengenai produk, layanan, serta prinsip perbankan syariah Pengembangan kompetensi analitis, komunikasi, dan leadership Pendampingan langsung dari mentor dan profesional berpengalaman Kesempatan berkarier dalam lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dengan budaya kerja berbasis integritas, pelayanan, dan kinerja Program ini dirancang untuk membentuk individu yang siap berkontribusi secara optimal dalam mendukung pertumbuhan bisnis serta memberikan layanan terbaik kepada nasabah. Persyaratan Umum: Lulusan Sarjana (S1) dan Magister (S2)

jobs.title: Entrepreneur Intern
jobs.description: About SeeSicht Gmbh SeeSicht is a small family office of AI-first companies. We build companies that are profitable today and keep them for the long term — not a venture builder chasing funding rounds. Every project is funded 100% by me or by me and my network. No investor search, no fundraising rounds. Your first months at SeeSicht Gmbh You will take on core business development tasks, working alongside experienced team members to support company initiatives. Through daily operations, you will learn how the business scales and manage assigned projects within a hybrid work environment. What you will do You execute. I bring the ideas, the network and the money — you turn them into real products, pages, campaigns and processes. You build and test the way we always do it: build a sellable prototype (CHF 100–1,000), test it on the market with Facebook ads (CHF 5,000–10,000), build the product fully (CHF 10,000–20,000), then launch with real marketing spend. MyBikePlan is the proof: 2019 idea, one-week website, one week of Facebook marketing, CHF 500 invested → 30 pre-orders. 2020 launch with CHF 1M in the first year, 2021 team, 2025 sold close to CHF 20M. The playbook is set — you run it on new projects. Current projects: Fairbroker.ch (AI insurance broker, market test now, live Q1 2027), a kettlebell workout app (52-card deck, early prototype, suppliers in China secured), and Glanzio (B2B store-window cleaning, launch test Q1 2027). The timeline — how it works Months 1–12 — the internship: CHF 2,500/month, full-time, paid, and inside that year up to 10% of the profit of the project/company you work on. From month 13 — the stake: the internship is over and you get a stake in the company, up to 10% equity, with a base salary of at least CHF 5,000/month — plus the up to 10% profit share on top. Sie fungieren als Bindeglied zwischen dem Kunden und dem Team in Bulgarien und unterstützen diese mit Ihrem technischen Wissen und umfassenden Erfahrungen. Sie werden den Kunden regelmäßig besuchen. Sie sind für Kundenbeziehungen verantwortlich und der Hauptansprechpartner für unsere Kunden bei den betreffenden Projekten in einem komplexen, anspruchsvollen und sich häufig ändernden Umfeld. jobs.description: About MakiPeople Maki builds AI agents that help large companies hire faster and better, from screening to assessment to candidate engagement. Global enterprises use Maki to run hiring at scale, giving recruiters time back and candidates a smoother experience. With offices in Paris and London, we are now accelerating in New York. As an intern on our Implementation team, you will work on live customer rollouts and see how AI is deployed inside large organizations. You will get real responsibility and close mentorship from day one. About the Implementation team You will be joining our Implementation team and will be working with our UE-based team, collaborating across EMEA and Asia, and alongside both our Implementation Managers (IMs) and our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs). You will also have the chance to collaborate with everyone at Maki. Most of the Implementation team’s efforts are currently focused on onboarding our (many) new clients, making sure they can use Maki to its fullest potential and that the impact we promise is delivered. Because we support large Enterprise companies, this is large-scale project management and change management, built hand-in-hand with our clients. About your mission As an Implementation Intern, you will support our Implementation Managers and Forward Deployed Engineers with a variety of operational tasks while actively contributing to live client projects. Your role is multi-faceted and cuts across several parts of the customer journey, with a strong focus on configuration, testing and cross-team collaboration. AI agent configuration: Configure Maki’s AI agents to match each client’s needs and hiring processes. jobs.title: CEO, AI Stockbroking
jobs.description: About ActAI There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. About the Role The CEO - AI Stockbroking will build and own an AI-native stockbroking business. The role combines brokerage infrastructure and market expertise with AI-native research, discovery and trading experiences. What you will be doing Define the AI Stockbroking proposition, product roadmap and business model. Build AI-native experiences across stock discovery, research, trading, portfolio management and market information. Own P&L, funded accounts, assets, trading activity, revenue and unit economics. Build the brokerage product and underlying trading, custody and market infrastructure. Work deeply with product, engineering and AI teams on product capabilities and execution. Own brokerage, custody, market data and other key partnerships. Build the core team and drive licensing, regulatory readiness and market expansion. jobs.description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. jobs.title: Senior All-Source Investigator, Severe Harms
jobs.description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. About the Role Sextortion — extorting money or further imagery from victims, disproportionately minors, under threat of releasing explicit images — has been named a national emergency by the FBI and NCMEC, and financial sextortion cases have been directly linked to a rise in teen suicides. In parallel, CSAM distribution networks increasingly monetize through cryptocurrency, using crypto's speed and pseudonymity to move money across borders faster than any single agency can follow. TRM's Severe Harms pod exists to close that gap. We fuse on-chain and off-chain intelligence to trace the financial rails behind this abuse, working alongside Law Enforcement and Government Partners, and TRM's financial-institution and exchange partners to identify offenders, disrupt activity, and support victim identification and safeguarding. It is some of the most consequential and difficult work at TRM. As a Severe Harms All-Source Investigator , you will be one of the investigators running that flywheel every day — tracing the financial rails behind sextortion and CSAM monetization, building the target packages and legal-process returns that lead to disruption, and working cases from referral through to an actionable outcome. This is an individual-contributor role for someone who wants to do the work directly, not manage it. You will build genuine casework skill on some of the most consequential and difficult material at TRM, with a manager and a Lead Investigator supporting your growth. jobs.description: SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the physics and geometry of our world. Our mission is to redefine how industries, from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema, generate and interact with physically-grounded 3D environments. We're looking for bold, innovative individuals driven by a passion for pushing the boundaries of generative 3D AI. You should thrive in an environment where creativity meets technical challenge and be fearless in tackling the hardest problems in 3D world modeling. Our team is built on a foundation of dedication and a shared commitment to excellence, so we value people who take immense pride in their work and place the collective goals of the team above personal ambition. As a part of SpAItial, you'll be at the forefront of building World Models that bridge generative AI and the physical world. If you're ready to make an impact, embrace the unknown, and collaborate with a talented group of visionaries, we want to hear from you. We're seeking PhD Research Interns to work with our research team on open problems in 3D generation and reconstruction. You should have strong knowledge of at least one of our core areas, such as generative video and diffusion models, scene representations like Gaussian splats and radiance fields, or 3D reconstruction from per-scene optimization to feed-forward models. Over a 5-7 month internship, you will own a well-defined research question with the goal of publishing a paper. Responsibilities You will explore novel research directions in 3D generation, reconstruction, and world models. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineering Consultant
jobs.description: Als Senior Data Engineering Consultant bij BigData Republic adviseer je toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland over complexe data-vraagstukken. Je combineert hands-on engineering met een adviserende rol: je schrijft productie-klare code, denkt mee over strategische bedrijfsbeslissingen en begeleidt collega’s om naar een hoger niveau te groeien. Je hebt je carrière opgebouwd rond het ontwerpen en bouwen van datasystemen. Je werkt graag inhoudelijk mee, maar verliest kwaliteit, schaalbaarheid en duurzaamheid nooit uit het oog. Je bent een ervaren Data Engineer die vaak moeilijk in één functie te vatten is, omdat je op meerdere niveaus impact maakt. En je bent toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging. Bij BigData Republic ontwikkelen we data-applicaties, bouwen we data-platformen, creëren we voorspellende modellen en ontwerpen we robuuste data-infrastructuren. We werken vanuit een software-engineering mindset, met focus op technische hoogstaande kwaliteit. Kennisdeling en thought leadership vormen de kern van onze cultuur. Elke vrijdag organiseren we kennissessies op kantoor, we schrijven blogs, organiseren meetups en bezoeken en spreken op conferenties. Je werkt aan complexe projecten voor grote klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren, terwijl je onderdeel bent van een klein, informeel en hecht team van vakgenoten dat elkaar uitdaagt en inspireert. Bij BigData Republic ben je de expert in de kamer én leer je elke dag van je collega’s. En vooral: je kunt hier jezelf zijn. In de praktijk besteed je ongeveer 90% van je tijd aan klantprojecten. De overige tijd is expliciet gereserveerd voor eigen initiatieven: een pet project, innovatie of een idee dat je samen met collega’s wilt uitwerken. Je past goed bij deze rol als je ervaring hebt met (een deel van) onderstaande tooling en concepten: Je hebt een sterke basis in; Python Cloud (AWS, GCP of Azure) Data pipelines bouwen en ouderhouden (ELT/ ETL) Data warehousing (Databricks, Snowflake of BigQuery) Orchestratie (Airflow, Dagster) Terraf

You combine excellent formulation skills with the confidence to tackle development projects independently. You will remain closely involved in hands-on laboratory work while taking responsibility for assigned projects, guiding fellow medior and junior chemists, and working directly with clients and cross-functional teams to bring high-performing products to market. Develop and optimize haircare, hairstyling, and hair color formulations through hands-on laboratory work, ensuring product performance, safety, quality, and regulatory compliance. jobs.title: Head of CMC Data Management
jobs.description: Join Excelya , where Audacity, Care and Energy define who we are and how we work. We believe in creating ambitious solutions and fostering an inclusive environment where collaboration and individual growth go hand in hand. This role offers an exciting opportunity to lead and shape the Data Management strategy within a global CMC environment. As Head of CMC Data Management , you will drive data governance, lead a team of Data Managers, and prepare CMC data foundations to support future Data Science and Artificial Intelligence initiatives. Key Responsibilities Define and lead the CMC Data Management roadmap . Establish and maintain Data Governance frameworks, standards, and processes . Lead, coach, and develop a team of Data Managers . Define and manage data standards, reference data, and master data practices . Ensure data quality, consistency, reliability, and compliance across CMC activities. Oversee the Data Lifecycle Management process. Prepare and structure data to enable future Data Science and AI use cases . Collaborate closely with CMC, R&D, Data, Digital, and IT teams. jobs.description: PT Mayora Indah Tbk adalah perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang pengolahan makanan dan minuman. Berdiri pada tahun 1977 dengan pabrik pertama berlokasi di Tangerang dengan target market wilayah Jakarta dan sekitarnya. Setelah sanggup memenuhi pasar Indonesia, Perseroan melakukan Penawaran Umum Perdana dan menjadi perusahaan publik pada tahun 1990 dengan target market; konsumen Asean. Kemudian melebarkan sayapnya ke negara negara di Asia. Dan saat ini produk Perseroan telah tersebar di 5 benua di dunia. Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja PT Mayora Indah Tbk. Bisnis ini berkembang dan Grup Mayora kemudian secara resmi didirikan pada tahun 1977 dan sejak itu telah berkembang menjadi perusahaan global yang diakui dalam industri Fast Moving Consumer Goods. Beragam produk kami dapat dibagi menjadi 8 kategori: biskuit, permen, wafer, coklat, kopi, makanan instan, minuman dan sereal. Di antara merek terkenal kami adalah Kopiko, Danisa, Roma, Energen, Torabika, Beng Beng dan masih banyak lagi. S1 Semua Jurusan IPK min. 3,00 Memiliki pengalaman min. 1 tahun di bidang administrasi Memiliki kemampuan mengoperasikan Ms.Office terutama Ms.Excel Memiliki kemampuan untuk analisa biaya Memiliki ketelitian dan loyalitas yang tinggi Penempatan: Lampung 2. KEPALA GUDANG Mengawasi penerimaan dan pengeluaran barang sesuai dengan dokumen, menjaga barang dan kondisi gudang, mengoordinir dan mengawasi kegiatan operasional gudang agar berjalan sesuai prosedur yang ditetapkan. jobs.description: PT Pamapersada Nusantara (PAMA) adalah bagian dari Astra Heavy Equipment, Mining, Construction & Energy yang telah menjadi pionir dalam dunia kontraktor pertambangan dengan pangsa pasar terbesar di Indonesia. Rekrutmen PT Pamapersada Nusantara (PAMA). PAMA melayani berbagai klien dari bisnis pertambangan untuk menghasilkan produk pertambangan dan energi dengan selalu berkomitmen terhadap prinsip ESG dan mengedepankan aspek kontinuitas serta keberlanjutan sebagai tujuan utama. Untuk itu, PAMA terus tumbuh dengan cepat dan menciptakan inovasi berkesinambungan secara konsisten. Saat ini, PAMA mengajak talenta-talenta baru untuk bergabung dan berkembang bersama dalam menjawab tantangan dunia pertambangan. Kantor Pusat PT Pamapersada Nusantara di Jl.Rawagelam I No. 9, Kawasan Industri Pulogadung, Jakarta 13930, Indonesia Rekrutmen PT Pamapersada Nusantara (PAMA) Saat ini PT Pamapersada Nusantara (PAMA) membuka rekrutmen untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: Fresh Graduate Development Program (FGDP) 1. Management Development Officer Uraian Pekerjaan: Memfasilitasi Project Management dalam rangka penyusunan rencana kerja strategis, operasional dan target, memastikan implementasi dan memonitor pelaksanaannnya. Mendukung organisasi dalam rangka pelaksanaan sistem manajemen mutu maupun pelaksanaan strategic improvement site Memfasilitasi Project Management dalam pelaksanaan tinjauan dan evaluasi terhadap semua perencanaan kerja dan pencapaian kinerja Memfasilitasi pelaksanaan Plan-Do-Check-Action organisasi secara close loop. jobs.title: Event Specialist
jobs.description: Primary Tasks Lead the conceptualization, planning, and execution of events, from pre-production to post-event evaluation. Create and manage event timelines, checklists, and budgets to ensure smooth and cost-efficient execution. Oversee venue selection, supplier coordination, and vendor negotiations, ensuring quality and adherence to timelines. Manage permits, logistics, security, and technical requirements for each event. Coordinate with internal teams (Production, Creative, Marketing, PR, Finance) to ensure all deliverables are aligned. Prepare event documentation and post-event reports, including evaluations and cost summaries. Act as the event lead on-site, ensuring that all teams and suppliers perform as scheduled. Supervise setup, rehearsals, run-of-show, and pack-down activities. Troubleshoot and make real-time decisions during events to address any unforeseen issues. Work in tandem with the Executive Producer to align production coverage and live multimedia needs. Coordinate with the Marketing and Accounts Teams for partner requirements, branding placements, and deliverables. Maintain clear communication with sponsors, suppliers, and stakeholders before, during, and after each event. Secondary Tasks (During Lean Periods) Assist the marketing team in campaign coordination, partnership fulfillment, and client servicing. Support in crafting event proposals, sponsorship decks, and presentations for potential partners. Help manage marketing collaterals, promotional materials, and PR coordination. Conduct post-event partner evaluations and recommend ways to strengthen partnerships.
